scope: First-party static source asset budget. Counts LF-normalized known text source bytes and exact binary bytes for the HTML document and local URLs in stylesheet, icon, manifest, preload, modulepreload, script, image, source, audio, and video tags, plus local CSS url() dependencies. Excludes external resources, iframe contents, dynamic requests, transfer compression, cache behavior, and timing. It is not actual network bytes or Core Web Vitals.
